snippet.description:
Download BGMI now: https://bgmi.go.link/2w5kg

It all comes down to this, the final day of the BMPS 2026 Semi Finals.
After days of intense competition, the battle for direct qualification reaches its climax. All 24 teams across Groups A, B & C have one last chance to secure a Top 6 finish and book their place in the Grand Finals.

For some, it's a shot at direct qualification. For others, it's about staying alive and earning a place in the Last Chance stage. And for two teams, today could mark the end of their BMPS 2026 journey.

snippet.title: ALPHA | Official Teaser | Alia, Sharvari, Anil, Bobby | Shiv Rawail | YRF Spy Universe | 3 July 2026
snippet.description:
Welcome to the newest chapter of the YRF Spy Universe that presents an edgy origin story of a girl raised and built to kill. Alpha is a female-led action film that will take you on a fun, edge of the seat, thrilling ride that is designed as an out and out entertainer.

Yash Raj Films presents Alpha, starring Alia Bhatt, Sharvari, Anil Kapoor, and Bobby Deol. Produced by Aditya Chopra and directed by Shiv Rawail, acclaimed for the globally celebrated series The Railway Men, Alpha is set to release in theatres worldwide on July 3, 2026.

► Subscribe Now: https://goo.gl/xs3mrY 🔔 Stay updated!

About YRF Spy Universe:
YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, will release on 3 July 2026.

Mukkdi aa gall koi muka te sahi

snippet.title: BMPS 2026 Last Chance Stage Explained - Format, Teams, Schedule, and Qualification
snippet.description:
BMPS 2026 Semi Finals are done and 14 teams have locked their Jaipur Grand Finals spots. Only 2 remain - and 16 teams will fight for them at the Last Chance Stage.

Last Chance runs June 13-14 at NODWIN Gaming Arena, Delhi - same venue as the Semi Finals. Teams that finished 7th to 22nd in the Semi Finals overall standings qualify for this stage. 16 teams, 12 total matches across two days (6 per day). After 12 matches, only the Top 2 in overall standings go to the Grand Finals. The other 14 teams are eliminated.

This video breaks down why this is the most unforgiving stage of the tournament - no multiple rounds like Qualifiers, no 16-match cushion like Semi Finals. Just 12 matches, 2 spots, and almost zero margin for error. One poor rotation or one bad day can end an entire season.

BMPS 2026 Grand Finals: Jaipur, June 19-21, 16 teams, ₹4 crore prize pool, BMPS trophy and Esports World Cup 2026 qualification on the line.

Subscribe for Last Chance Stage results, Grand Finals coverage and BMPS 2026 updates.

localized.title: BMPS 2026 Last Chance Stage Explained - Format, Teams, Schedule, and Qualification
localized.description:
BMPS 2026 Semi Finals are done and 14 teams have locked their Jaipur Grand Finals spots. Only 2 remain - and 16 teams will fight for them at the Last Chance Stage.

Last Chance runs June 13-14 at NODWIN Gaming Arena, Delhi - same venue as the Semi Finals. Teams that finished 7th to 22nd in the Semi Finals overall standings qualify for this stage. 16 teams, 12 total matches across two days (6 per day). After 12 matches, only the Top 2 in overall standings go to the Grand Finals. The other 14 teams are eliminated.

This video breaks down why this is the most unforgiving stage of the tournament - no multiple rounds like Qualifiers, no 16-match cushion like Semi Finals. Just 12 matches, 2 spots, and almost zero margin for error. One poor rotation or one bad day can end an entire season.

BMPS 2026 Grand Finals: Jaipur, June 19-21, 16 teams, ₹4 crore prize pool, BMPS trophy and Esports World Cup 2026 qualification on the line.

Subscribe for Last Chance Stage results, Grand Finals coverage and BMPS 2026 updates.

तेरी राहों में बिछ जाऊँ, अगर तू मुस्कुराए,
तेरी ख़ुशी में अपनी हर सांस, मैं कुर्बान कर जाऊँ।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

कभी खामोशी में तेरा नाम लूँ, तो आँसू चल पड़ते हैं,
कभी तेरे ख़्वाबों में खो जाऊँ, तो लम्हे थम पड़ते हैं।
तेरे जाने के बाद भी, दिल तुझसे बातें करता है,
हर तन्हा रात में अब भी, तेरा ही ज़िक्र करता है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

अब बस इतना कह दूँ तुझसे, लौट आ किसी बहाने,
तेरे बिना ये दिल मेरा, टूटे पत्ते जैसा दीवाने।
तेरे प्यार में ही तो मेरी, दुनिया पूरी होती है,
तेरे आने से ही मेरी, ज़िंदगी रोशन होती है।

snippet.title: Thaakkol - Balan: The Boy | Sushin Shyam | Nila Raj | Anwar Ali | New Malayalam Song
snippet.description:
𝐓𝐡𝐚𝐚𝐤𝐤𝐨𝐥 is an original rhyme crafted in the spirit of the folk tales and playful verses many of us grew up with. It follows the story of a little frog searching for a lost key, journeying through the forest and asking different animals for help along the way. Unfolding through a lively call-and-response pattern, the song captures the simplicity, imagination, and wonder of childhood. Featured in Balan – The Boy, Thaakkol is a gentle reminder of the stories, games, and adventures that once filled our world.

Song: Thaakkol 
Movie: Balan: The Boy
Music Composer: Sushin Shyam
Lyricist: Anwar Ali
Lead Singer: Nila Raj
Choir: Aadya Aneesh, Milia Maria Noble, Samanwita Sarath, Abhiram Krishna, Bhadra Hari, Chinmayi Kiranlal, Dakshina IM
One Man Quartet: Rithu Vysakh
Mix Engineer: Abin Paul
Audio Mastered by Donal Whelan@Mastering world, U.K
Vocals Recorded at M Lounge
Recording Engineer Amal Raj
Project Manager: Uthara Krishnan
Artist Coordinator: Vincent KD

Cast - Adhisheshan, Farzana Palathingal, Muhammed Zinaan, Dolly June, Jean Paul Lal, Girish AD & Beena Antony
Directed By: Chidambaram 
Produced By: Venkat K Narayana, Shailaja Desai Fenn

Lyrics:
Kando kando thaakkol,
Kunjan thavalayude thaakkol.
Naattil thendi nadakkumbol,
Kaanaathaayoru thaakkol,
Kaanaathaayoru thaakkol...
Mann kuzhikkum njendalyaa,
Kando neeyaa thaakkol?
Kando neeyaa thaakkol?
Mann kuzhikkum neram,
Engane kaanum thaakkol...
Pattam ketti varum kombaa,
Nee kandodaa thaakkol?
Nee kandodaa thaakkol?
Kottum chendayilillallo,
Pottumamittilumillallo,
Payyin vaale thoongiyole,
Mundikokke nee kando?
Neettil ponthum meene,
Kannaale njaan kandullu.
Kombil njaalum vavvaale,
Kando velli thaakkol?
Kuttirittilumillallo,
Utharathilumillallo,
Chodhichangane poyyaare,
Neendu nivarnnu kidakkunnu,
Thaakkol poloru neerkkoli,
Thaakkol poloru neerkkoli.
Kunjan thavalachaarinnum,
Ellaarodum chodhichu:
"Thaakkol kando?"
"Pekkrom pekkrom!"
Veedin velli thaakkol.
"Thaakkol kando?"
"Pekkrom pekkrom!"
Minnaaminni thaakkol,
Minnaaminni thaakkol

Malayalam Lyrics:
കണ്ടോ കണ്ടോ താക്കോൽ
കണ്ടോ കണ്ടോ താക്കോൽ

കുഞ്ഞൻ തവളയുടെ താക്കോൽ
നാട്ടിൽ തേടി നടക്കുമ്പോൾ,
കാണാതായൊരു താക്കോൽ,
കാണാതായൊരു താക്കോൽ...

മൺകുഴിക്കും ഞണ്ടളിയാ,
കണ്ടോ നീയാ താക്കോൽ?
കണ്ടോ നീയാ താക്കോൽ?
മൺകുഴിക്കും നേരം
എങ്ങനെ കാണും താക്കോൽ...

പട്ടം കെട്ടി വരും കൊമ്പാ,
നീ കണ്ടോടാ താക്കോൽ?
നീ കണ്ടോടാ താക്കോൽ?
കൊട്ടും ചെണ്ടേലില്ലല്ലോ,
പൊട്ടുമിട്ടിലുമില്ലല്ലോ,
പയ്യിൻ വാലേ തൂങ്ങോളേ,
മുണ്ടിക്കൊക്കേ നീ കണ്ടോ?

നീറ്റിൽ പൊന്തും മീനേ,
കണ്ണാലേ ഞാൻ കണ്ടുള്ളൂ.
കൊമ്പിൽ ഞാലും വവ്വാലേ,
കണ്ടോ വെള്ളി താക്കോൽ?

കുറ്റിരിട്ടിലുമില്ലല്ലോ,
ഉത്തരത്തിലുമില്ലല്ലോ,
ചോദിച്ചങ്ങനെ പോയാറെ,
നീണ്ടുനിവർന്നു കിടക്കുന്നു
താക്കോൽ പോലൊരു നീർക്കോലി,
താക്കോൽ പോലൊരു നീർക്കോലി.

കുഞ്ഞൻ തവളച്ചാരിന്നും
എല്ലാരോടും ചോദിപ്പു:
“താക്കോൽ കണ്ടോ?”
പെക്ക്റോം പെക്ക്റോം!

വീടിൻ വെള്ളി താക്കോൽ,
താക്കോൽ കണ്ടോ?
പെക്ക്റോം പെക്ക്റോം!

മിന്നാമിന്നി താക്കോൽ,
